item.title: Northwest Strength: Office Interest Splits as Regional Markets Diverge
item.description: Northwest Arkansas exceeds regional and national expectations with exceedingly low vacancy in office real estate, which is struggling elsewhere. Central Arkansas saw its vacancy rate rise as the year continued, though it’s still only about half the national average. Velocity is low outside of the major metros.
